summary: Tested the unified Local Driver (Rent a Driver / Book a Driver) backend and UI, plus regression. Backend: iter17 14/14, new iter18 edge-case suite 14/14 (legacy rent-only drivers, PUT /pro/settings book without vehicles -> 400, PUT /pro/vehicles, dashboard earnings after arriving/start/complete, customer cancel notifies every dispatched driver, destination taluk with drivers only in the pickup taluk -> 404, review, admin hire-reports), iter16 17/17, iter15 25/28 (all 3 failures come from the intended semantic change, not real bugs), carpool iter13 10/10 and trips/search 200. Frontend at 390x844 works end to end: /hire chooser cards and both forms, destination taluk card (Hiriyur from a Gajwel pickup), results with group badge, vehicle and estimate, favourite toggle, request-this-driver -> /hire/requests; as the driver: inbox with service badge, Accept -> /hire/HIR-..., vehicle shown, I am arriving (customer notified), dashboard status chips and 4 tabs, save vehicles; /hire/register service picker and vehicle editor; customer booking page with contact, favourite, report and cancel; admin Local drivers (service filter), Driver hire bookings and Driver reports open with no crash. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView issues found. Main problems: wrong 'driving your car' fee text on Book a Driver screens, and cancel actions with no confirmation step.

minor.issue: rate_limit('hirereq') runs only after the eligibility queries and only on success. 404 'no drivers' probes are unlimited and each runs 2 driver queries.
No time check. A driver can start or complete a booking days before starts_at, which also moves earnings early.
Book a Driver can be turned on when every vehicle is marked unavailable. The driver then never matches and gets no warning.

The TestDriverFlow admin fixture logs in through /api/auth/login, which now returns 403 for admins ('must sign in through the Admin Portal'). It is outdated test infrastructure, not an app bug; carpool was checked with test_iter13_retest_fixes.py instead.

ui_bugs.component: Fee note under results / booking detail
ui_bugs.issue: v2.service_fee_note ('This is the driver's service fee for driving your car - not a carpool fuel contribution') is shown for Book a Driver too, where the driver brings the car and the estimate includes the vehicle charge. Reference: /app/frontend/app/hire/index.tsx:223, /app/frontend/app/hire/[id].tsx:84

One tap cancels at once with no confirmation (checked: hire-cancel-button cancelled HIR booking instantly). Easy to cancel by accident on mobile. Reference: /app/frontend/app/hire/[id].tsx:96, /app/frontend/app/hire/requests.tsx:74

Submitting the empty form shows only 'City *' in pro-error. There is also a separate 'City' field (pro-city-field) at the bottom besides Home location City/Town, which is confusing. Reference: /app/frontend/app/hire/register.tsx
A cancelled booking shows 'Phone number is shown after the booking is confirmed', which is misleading once the booking is cancelled. Reference: /app/frontend/app/hire/[id].tsx

issues: Stepper +/- buttons are 40x40, below the 44pt minimum (src/components/ui.tsx:313).
Hire results for Hiriyur list 9 drivers, mostly TEST_ drivers from repeated test runs, including duplicate names (TEST_HireBOTH17 x2). This is data pollution in the shared DB, not a UI bug.

Document thumbnails showed as empty grey boxes in the screenshot (taken about 2.5s after load). /api/files/{fid} returns 200 image/jpeg, so this may only be load time. Please check that the thumbnails actually render.

action_items: Show a Book-a-Driver fee note (driver fee + vehicle charge, driver provides the car) instead of v2.service_fee_note when service === 'book' (hire/index.tsx:223, hire/[id].tsx:84).
Add a confirmation (Alert / modal) before cancelling a hire booking and before cancelling an open request.
Make the registration validation message clear (e.g. 'Choose your city') and merge or relabel the extra 'City' field so it is not confused with Home location City/Town.
Hide the 'Phone number is shown after the booking is confirmed' hint on cancelled or completed bookings.

Optional: enlarge Stepper buttons to 44x44; move rate_limit in POST /hire/requests before the eligibility search; block start/complete well before starts_at; warn when Book a Driver is on but no vehicle is available.
Optional: update or retire the admin fixture in test_travoo_api.py (admin must use /api/admin/auth/login).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3,596 lines, far beyond 700. Split the hire/local-driver code (pro_*, hire_*, eligible_local_drivers, accept_locked, admin hire views) into its own router module.
The accept path is sound: per-driver hire_locks plus an atomic open->fulfilled find_one_and_update plus a post-insert clash rollback. Two drivers accepting at once gave exactly [200, 409] in tests.

Destination-taluk matching is correct: local_area = home or service_taluk_codes; nearby requires accepts_outside_area; outstation requires accepts_outstation and adds pickup-taluk drivers only as nearby/pickup_area.
Legacy profiles without a services field are treated as rent-only everywhere (svc_q, admin listing, favourites, dashboard) - verified.

The startup log shows 'object storage init failed: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY' (the key is not in backend/.env and not in the process environ), but file upload and GET /api/files work at runtime. Check where the key comes from so a cold start does not break uploads.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iter17_unified_local_driver.py test_iter18_local_driver_edges.py -c /dev/null -p no:xdist -v. The admin token is cached in /tmp/admtok (admin login is rate limited). iter15 known semantic failures: test_nearby_group / test_nearby_broadcast_decline_cancel (driver D lacks accepts_outside_area, now required for nearby) and test_broadcast_local (expects pickup_taluk = subdistrict_code; pickup_taluk is now only set from pickup_subdistrict_code). Web login: language-option-en -> language-continue-button -> auth-toggle-mode -> auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. LocationField: tap field -> location-search-input -> location-option-* (OSM, 'Gajwel' / 'Hiriyur' work). Stepper values use the {testID}-value / -plus / -minus suffix (e.g. hire-days-value). Server clock is 2026-11-13.
rca_of_issue: iter15 regression failures: (1) nearby_area now requires accepts_outside_area=True, and iter15 driver D (Holalkere) was registered without it, so it is no longer offered as nearby - intended by the new rule. (2) pickup_taluk is now built from pickup_subdistrict_code (subdistrict_code is the destination), and the old test sends no pickup code, so pickup_taluk is None - intended. Neither is a product bug.
